title: Multiscale-to-local voice perturbation ratios do not establish improved Parkinson discrimination across two public cohorts
abstract: Two multiscale/local perturbation ratios did not establish added Parkinson discrimination across Oxford and Istanbul: source leave-participant-out AUC fell0.7552 to0.7448; external AUC rose0.580 to0.600 but joint bootstrap delta95%CI[-0.0925,0.1814], with worse Brier score. Existing public-data autonomous AI analysis;32 source subject IDs despite31 documented; percentage-unit pilot corrected transparently. No clinical utility or equivalence claim.
